b: A reader asked about the best way to score discounts on Milwaukee M18 FORGE batteries. Good news, there are some deals worth considering.
There’s an ongoing deal at Home Depot where you buy a select tool or accessory bundle, and you get a FREE FORGE 8Ah battery.

At the end of the season, there are always folks who ask when this deal will return. From what I’ve seen, this is it. If you miss this deal, you’ll have to wait until next year for an opportunity to save this much money again.
There are a bunch of high-performance Milwaukee M18 FUEL cordless power tools in that promo list. Buy the tool, get a free FORGE battery.
This is one of the best deals in my opinion, where you buy a bundle with the Milwaukee 2-bay Super Charger and an 8Ah battery.
You get all this, the awesome fast smart charger, plus 2x FORGE 8Ah batteries, for $349.
Just the Super Charger by itself sells for $249. So for $100 more you 2 of Milwaukee’s best XC-sized M18 battery.
This other deal is really good too.
Buy the Milwaukee M18 FORGE 12Ah battery, get a FORGE 8Ah battery for FREE.
That’s what it typically costs for the 12Ah battery. But here, you get an 8Ah battery too.
Are FOREG batteries worth it? YES. In my experiences so far they’ve delivered outstanding performance. This deal gives you one of each.

It’s a good way to start exploring the upgraded power delivery of FORGE batteries. This deal gives you size variety, the other bundle gives you a Super Charger and the popular 8Ah battery. Decisions, decisions. Or get both.
